population_note: the 20 institutional_ strategies in output_r5_merged_1_7 minus institutional_committed_growth_long (already graded by its own Step-2 campaign, holdout 0.757 FAIL 5-of-6)
mechanism: per sibling, ONE read: exit selected on IN-SAMPLE rows only (roster_core.select_exit objective=gates min_n=10, the same selector as the icg Step-2 grade); that exit's HOLDOUT rows graded once via roster_core.evaluate(min_n=10); verdict = the six LIVE_GATES (pooled_sharpe>=1.0, profit_factor>=1.3, sortino>=1.0, psr>=0.95, min_trades_holdout>=15, min_trades_full_period>=75). No re-selection, no second read.

decision_rules_registered_before_running.R1: a sibling earns CAMPAIGN CONSIDERATION only if its NON-SHARED-with-icg holdout trades (entries absent from icg's entry set) number >= 15 AND grade pooled_sharpe > 0.757 - the full-population trigger was struck by the costed Contrarian objection (the max of 19 correlated readings exceeds 0.757 by chance even when every true level equals icg's; the first grade, multi_quarter 0.803 on 94%-shared trades, is that inflation live)
decision_rules_registered_before_running.R2: a sibling with trade overlap < 80% vs icg earns campaign consideration regardless of grade (the proxy argument does not reach it)
decision_rules_registered_before_running.otherwise: the sibling closes with an EXECUTED grade (never a proxy stamp); after all 19, the family closes and the programme moves to a different producer chain, its target selected through the S6-B2627a collinearity pre-gate

reporting_mitigation: every reported row carries its overlap-with-icg percentage inline, so a future reader cannot mistake 19 correlated grades for independent evidence
cost_basis: EXECUTED 2026-09-06: one load+grade measured 18s; 19 siblings upper-bounded ~6 min (single load amortises); zero engine hours
